protocol.dataset: UCI Wine, Aeberhard & Forina (1992), DOI 10.24432/C5PC7J, CC BY 4.0
protocol.selection: For each (family,k), choose restart by highest train log likelihood, tie by lower seed. Then choose configuration by lowest validation NLL, tie by family then k. Test used only after selection. No refit on validation.
protocol.initialization: uniform weights; distinct random training row centers; pooled covariance with the same floor constraint
protocol.standardization: training-only mean/population std; floor in squared standardized units
protocol.labels: source class identifier is stripped by the loader and never returned
protocol.metrics: mean negative natural log density in standardized 13D coordinates; original-unit NLL also reported via training-scale Jacobian
protocol.retained: all 24 fits, complete mean likelihood/Q/KL/floor histories, initial and final parameters, final transition witnesses

collapse.limit: unbounded above as sigma tends to zero; no finite unconstrained global maximum on this path

covariance_update.meaning: Smaller is the exact fixed-responsibility covariance objective. Eigenvalue clipping solves this constrained subproblem; adding floor*I generally does not.
